'''Pride Aully''' was a [[humanoid]] scoundrel. Aully participated in a [[sabacc]] game on the [[planet]] [[Numidian Prime]] in [[10 BBY]], where the outlaw [[Han Solo]] won the [[starship]] ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' from the [[gambler]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]].

Aully was active [[Standard year|years]] later, during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], and sought to buy a [[Z-6 jetpack]]. After hearing that such a [[jetpack]] could be found at [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the planet [[Batuu]], Aully contacted a visitor to the [[City|town]], requesting confirmation. The visitor investigated, confirming Aully's information, and the scoundrel intended to travel to Batuu to retrieve the jetpack.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Finally! I'll send Kasif a transmission and let him know I'll pick it up when he gets back. Thanks for the help. Here's your payment.|Pride Aully, to the visitor on Batuu|<ref name="Datapad" />}}
[[File:NumidianPrimeGamblers.png|thumb|left|280px|Pride Aully participated in a sabacc game on Numidian Prime.]]
In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Solo Date">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' dates the events of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' to nine [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Solo'', including Pride Aully's appearance, are set in [[10 BBY]].</ref> Aully was present at<ref name="Solo" /> a [[jungle outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Numidian Prime]],<ref name="Solo Expanded Edition">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]''</ref> taking part in a game of [[sabacc]] alongside the [[gambler]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]]. During the game, the scoundrels [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]], who had previously hired the gambler and his [[starship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', as part of a [[Raid on Kessel|heist]], entered the outpost in search of Calrissian.<ref name="Solo" />

Calrissian left the table to greet his former associates, who challenged the gambler to a game of sabacc. Aully spectated the sabacc game, during which Solo won the ''Millennium Falcon'' from Calrissian.<ref name="Solo" /> Following the game, Aully and the other gamblers that had been present later told different accounts of the events, with each spectator emphasizing different details, though their accounts all agreed on the game's final moments.<ref name="Solo Junior">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: A Junior Novel]]''</ref>

Around [[34 ABY|forty-four]] [[Standard year|years]] later,<ref name="Galaxy's Edge Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the [[Battle of Batuu|mission to Batuu]], which includes the [[First Order]]'s occupation of [[Batuu]], to six [[Standard month|months]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. As such, the events depicted in {{DatapadCite|Need Jetpack. Have Credits.|PrideAullyMission-GEDatapad.jpg|PrideAullyConv-GEDatapad.png|PrideAullyConv2-GEDatapad.jpg|PrideAullyConv3-GEDatapad.jpg|PrideAullyComplete-GEDatapad.jpg}} must take place around that year.</ref> during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], Aully wished to acquire a [[Z-6 jetpack]], having heard that one could be found at the business [[Outer Rim Expedition and Supply]] in the [[City|town]] of [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the planet [[Batuu]]. Wanting to verify that the [[jetpack]] was available before flying to Batuu, Aully contacted a visitor to Black Spire Outpost, requesting confirmation. The visitor investigated the business' supply of crates and determined that Aully's information was correct. Aully thanked the visitor with a transfer of one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], intending to contact the business owner [[Kasif]] about collecting the jetpack.<ref name="Datapad" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'm not flying all the way to Batuu unless it's there.|Pride Aully|<ref name="Datapad" />}}
Aully was a [[humanoid]] individual<ref name="Solo" /> who was a self-proclaimed scoundrel.<ref name="Datapad" /> On Numidian Prime, Aully and the other gamblers were disgruntled while facing Calrissian in sabacc.<ref name="Solo Expanded Edition" /> Calrissian perceived his fellow gamblers to be ill-tempered and menacing.<ref name="Solo Junior" /> When searching for a Z-6 jetpack, Aully refused to put in the effort to travel to Batuu without knowing whether one was available there.<ref name="Datapad" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|If you find a Z-6 I will reward you for your troubles.|Pride Aully, to the visitor on Batuu|<ref name="Datapad" />}}
Aully wore [[Color|red]] [[armor]], a face-concealing [[helmet]], and black [[glove]]s.<ref name="Solo" /> Aully wished to acquire a Z-6 [[jetpack]] from Black Spire Outpost, and would not settle for any other model.<ref name="Datapad" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pride Aully first appeared in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology]] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo" /> The character's name was first revealed in [[Star Wars: Datapad|''Star Wars'': Datapad]], the mobile app companion to the [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]] theme park land,<ref name="Datapad" /> which opened to guests at [[Disneyland]] and [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]] in [[2019]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=creatures-droids-and-aliens-meet-the-fantastical-figures-of-star-wars-galaxys-edge|text=Creatures, Droids, and Aliens: Meet the Fantastical Figures of ''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge}}</ref> Aully's armor was depicted as being entirely white in ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Graphic Novel Adaptation|Star Wars: Solo Graphic Novel Adaptation]]'', written by [[Alessandro Ferrari]], illustrated by [[Roberto Santillo]], and published by [[IDW Publishing]]<ref name="Graphic Novel">[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Solo: A Star Wars Story'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]]</ref> on [[March 26]], 2019.<ref name="GNDate">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/589694/star-wars-solo-graphic-novel-adaptation-by-alessandro-ferrari/9781684053919|text=Star Wars: Solo Graphic Novel Adaptation}}</ref> The chest armor worn by Aully in ''Solo''<ref name="Solo" /> was reused for the character [[Plesko Marno]]<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> in the 2019 [[sequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>
